correctness.rationale: From z1=x^3,z2=y^3 and the k=3 non-diagonal boundary equations, xy=a(a-1), lambda=1/[a^2(a-1)], and positivity/distinctness force 1<a<4/3. Direct independent SymPy rational-function simplification gives lambda^2*z1*z2=(a-1)/a, denominator=1/[a(a-1)], so s2=kappa=(a-1)^2. With t=a-1, F(t)=9t^2/(1+t+2t^2+t^3), F'(t)=9t(2+t-t^3)/(1+t+2t^2+t^3)^2>0 on (0,1/3), endpoint 27/43 and KS strict upper 1/9. Primary full text explicitly states the k^2*kappa*gamma<1 sufficient condition and formulas; Martinelli--Sinclair--Weitz derivation supplies gamma<=lambda/(1+lambda). Endpoint excluded; no finite testing substituted for continuum proof.
